title: Grilled Australian Corn on the Cob
description: A simple and delicious side dish that brings out the natural sweetness of Australian corn. Perfect for summer BBQs or picnics.
instructions: Shuck the corn and remove any silk.
Brush the corn with melted butter, if using.
Grill the corn for 10-12 minutes, turning every 2-3 minutes, until slightly charred.
Remove the corn from the grill and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve immediately, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
